purpose: State the company mission with team photography

responsive.phone: Photo pair and center track image sit in a fixed 390x511 box (see PHOTO_BOX phone values, 80px squares).
responsive.tablet: Box becomes the full max-width container (tablet:max-w-container tablet:w-full tablet:h-full); photo squares grow to 100px; track image widens to 110% (tablet:top-[340px] tablet:w-[110%]); heading steps to tablet:text-title-t.
responsive.desktop: Photo squares grow again to 140px (per PHOTO_BOX desktop values); track image widens further to 120% (desktop:top-[400px] desktop:w-[120%]); heading steps to desktop:text-title; outer bottom padding grows (desktop:pb-[300px]).
